# BigQuery's unsupported types: third_party/bigquery_docs/reference/standard-sql/federated_query_functions.md
# Fixtures: tests/e2e/mysql.sql.

SELECT * FROM EXTERNAL_QUERY('us.mysql', 'SELECT bit_value FROM types')
=> error contains: Found unsupported MySQL type in BigQuery.

SELECT * FROM EXTERNAL_QUERY('us.mysql', 'SELECT geometry_value FROM types')
=> error contains: Found unsupported MySQL type in BigQuery.

SELECT * FROM EXTERNAL_QUERY('us.mysql', 'SELECT nosuch')
=> error:

# Emulator limits, as for PostgreSQL.
SELECT * FROM EXTERNAL_QUERY('us.mysql', 'SELECT 1 AS x, 2 AS x')
=> error contains: The emulator does not support EXTERNAL_QUERY columns of the same name

SELECT * FROM EXTERNAL_QUERY('us.mysql', 'SELECT 1 AS x', '{"query_execution_priority":"low"}')
=> error contains: The emulator does not support EXTERNAL_QUERY option query_execution_priority
